name: @veniceai/mcp-server

tools.name: venice_chat
tools.description: Run an OpenAI-compatible chat completion via Venice's text-model catalog. Calls are non-streaming plaintext. enable_e2ee is rejected: this server does not encrypt chat. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

ttl.description: Optional extended cache TTL, for example "1h".

cache_control.description: Prompt cache control for providers that support it.

url.description: Public URL or base64 data URL for an image at least 64px square.

cache_control.description: Prompt cache control for providers that support it.

data.description: Base64-encoded audio bytes; direct audio URLs are not supported.

cache_control.description: Prompt cache control for providers that support it.

url.description: Public video URL, supported YouTube URL, or base64 video data URL.

cache_control.description: Prompt cache control for providers that support it.

file_data.description: Public file URL or base64 data URL.

cache_control.description: Prompt cache control for providers that support it.

messages.description: Chat messages. Multimodal image, audio, video, and file blocks belong in user messages.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum visible plus reasoning tokens. Preferred over deprecated max_tokens.

verbosity.description: How much text the model returns.

enable_web_search.description: Web search. "on" forces it, "auto" leaves it to the model, "off" (default) disables it.

enable_web_citations.description: Ask the model to cite web sources with ^1^ style superscripts. Only applies when web search ran.

enable_web_scraping.description: Scrape URLs found in the latest user message and feed the contents to the model.

include_venice_system_prompt.description: Keep Venice's default system prompt alongside your own. Defaults to true; set false for full control of behaviour.

character_slug.description: Public ID of a Venice character to answer in. Discoverable via venice_list_characters.

enable_x_search.description: Native xAI web + X/Twitter search, on supported models such as Grok. Runs server-side instead of Venice search.

strip_thinking_response.description: Remove <think></think> blocks from the response of a reasoning model.

disable_thinking.description: Turn reasoning off entirely on supported models, and strip the <think></think> blocks.

venice_parameters.description: Venice-only options: web search, citations, system prompt control, reasoning control, and characters.

timeout_ms.description: Upstream timeout for this call, covering the full response body. Long generations may need more than the VENICE_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS default.

tools.name: venice_responses
tools.description: Alpha, stateless OpenAI-compatible Responses API for Venice text models. Supports text/image input and reasoning controls, but this MCP tool does not advertise tool calling because the endpoint does not reliably accept those fields. E2EE-capable models are not supported. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

input.description: Plain text or an array of text/image message inputs.

enable_web_search.description: Web search. "on" forces it, "auto" leaves it to the model, "off" (default) disables it.

enable_web_citations.description: Ask the model to cite web sources with ^1^ style superscripts. Only applies when web search ran.

enable_web_scraping.description: Scrape URLs found in the latest user message and feed the contents to the model.

include_venice_system_prompt.description: Keep Venice's default system prompt alongside your own. Defaults to true; set false for full control of behaviour.

character_slug.description: Public ID of a Venice character to answer in. Discoverable via venice_list_characters.

venice_parameters.description: Venice-only options supported by /responses: web search, citations, scraping, system prompt control, characters.

tools.name: venice_embeddings
tools.description: Compute embeddings for text input (OpenAI-compatible). Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

tools.name: venice_image_generate
tools.description: Generate an image. Supports Flux 2 Pro/Max, Lustify SDXL, Anime (WAI), Qwen Image, GPT Image, Nano Banana Pro and others. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

quality.description: Model-specific quality tier; may change pricing.

enhance_prompt.description: Rewrite the prompt before generation. Adds up to ~30 seconds and a charge when applied.

image.description: Style image URL, data URI, or raw base64 (under 8MB).

style_references.description: Model-specific style references. Check the model maxStyleReferences capability.

aspect_ratio.description: Model-specific aspect ratio such as "1:1" or "16:9"; the API validates supported values.

resolution.description: Model-specific resolution tier such as "1K", "2K", or "4K"; the API validates supported values.

enable_web_search.description: Allow supported models to use web search; additional credits may apply.

disable_prompt_optimization_thinking.description: Skip prompt-optimization thinking on supported models.

variants.description: Number of images. Only supported with non-binary responses.

tools.name: venice_image_edit
tools.description: Edit an image with a prompt. Returns base64 PNG. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

image_url.description: URL of the image to edit (will be passed through to the edit endpoint).

model.description: Edit model id; defaults to firered-image-edit.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16", "4:5". Supported values vary by model; the API validates.

enhance_prompt.description: Rewrite the edit prompt with awareness of the input image. May add time and cost.

resolution.description: Model-specific output resolution tier; the API validates supported values.

tools.name: venice_image_multi_edit
tools.description: Edit multiple images together with a single prompt (multi-image composition / outpainting). Returns base64 PNG. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16", "4:5". Supported values vary by model; the API validates.

enhance_prompt.description: Rewrite the edit prompt with awareness of the input images. May add time and cost.

resolution.description: Model-specific output resolution tier; the API validates supported values.

quality.description: Model-specific quality tier; may change pricing.

tools.name: venice_image_upscale
tools.description: Upscale an image (2-4× scale). Endpoint requires base64 image; this tool fetches the URL and uploads it. Returns base64 PNG. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

scale.description: Upscale factor, 2 to 4. Defaults to 2. Large inputs are scaled down automatically to stay under the 4096x4096 output cap.

creativity.description: How much detail and texture the upscaler invents, 0 to 0.02. Defaults to 0.01. Higher stays further from the source.

tools.name: venice_image_remove_bg
tools.description: Remove image background; returns a transparent PNG (base64). Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

tools.name: venice_video_generate
tools.description: Queue a video generation. Supports Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling, Wan, LTX 2, Seedance, Runway Gen-4, and others. Pick a specific id like "veo3.1-fast-text-to-video", "veo3.1-fast-image-to-video", "kling-2.6-pro-text-to-video", "wan-2.6-text-to-video", "seedance-2-0-r2v" etc. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key. Returns { model, queue_id }; poll with venice_video_status. NOTE: 'duration' is a model-specific string enum like '4s' / '6s' / '8s'; inspect it with venice_model_details. Current public Seedance models may reject detectable persons outright. Consent flags are defensive compatibility support, not a policy bypass; set them only after showing a returned policy to the user and receiving explicit confirmation.

duration.description: Duration as model-specific string enum, e.g. "4s", "6s", "8s". See venice_model_details.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, e.g. "16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "9:21". Model-specific; see venice_model_details.

image_url.description: For image-to-video models: starting frame. URL or data URL.

end_image_url.description: For models that support end frames or transitions. URL or data URL.

video_url.description: For video-to-video models (e.g. seedance-2-0-r2v): input video. URL or data URL. Supported: MP4, MOV, WebM.

audio_url.description: For models that support audio input: background music. URL or data URL. Supported: WAV, MP3. Max 30s, 15MB.

reference_image_urls.description: For models with reference image support: up to 9 images for character/style consistency. Each a URL or data URL.

reference_video_urls.description: For Seedance 2.0 R2V and similar: up to 3 reference video clips to inherit subject motion, camera movement, and style. Per-clip 2–15s, MP4/MOV, ≤50MB; aggregate ≤15s. Each a URL or data URL.

reference_audio_urls.description: For Seedance 2.0 R2V and similar: up to 3 reference audio clips for vocal timbre, narration, or sound effects. Per-clip 2–15s, WAV/MP3; aggregate ≤15s. Must be paired with at least one reference image or video. Each a URL or data URL.

elements.description: For Kling O3 R2V and similar: up to 4 character/object elements. Reference in prompt as @Element1, @Element2, etc.

scene_image_urls.description: For models with advanced element support: up to 4 scene reference images. Reference in prompt as @Image1, @Image2, etc.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt (what to avoid). Supported by Seedance and other models.

resolution.description: Output resolution, e.g. "720p", "1080p", "4k". Model-specific; see venice_model_details.

upscale_factor.description: For upscale models only: 1 = quality enhance, 2 = double resolution, 4 = quadruple.

audio.description: Enable or disable audio generation for models that support it. Defaults to true.

confirmed_terms_and_privacy.description: Set true only after the user confirms the returned policy text and Venice terms/privacy.

confirmed_legal_right.description: Set true only after the user confirms legal rights/consent for every depicted person and all submitted media.

confirmed_screening_acknowledged.description: Set true only after the user acknowledges automated media screening.

consents.description: Defensive compatibility support for a returned Seedance needs_consent flow. Current public models may reject detectable persons outright. All three flags must be true after explicit user confirmation and cannot bypass content policy.

tools.name: venice_video_status
tools.description: Check status of a queued video job. Returns JSON progress while PROCESSING. Completed jobs are either an embedded base64 video/mp4 MCP resource or a download_url resource link. For VPS / Grok Imagine Private models, retrieve returns COMPLETED JSON without a URL: this process reuses the queue-time download_url when venice_video_generate ran here, or accepts a Venice-host download_url argument. POST endpoint with body {model, queue_id}. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

model.description: Same model id used to queue.

download_url.description: Queue-time download_url from venice_video_generate. Must be an https Venice host. Needed for VPS / Grok Imagine Private only when this process did not queue the job (retrieve returns COMPLETED without a URL).

delete_media_on_completion.description: Delete server-side media once an embedded MP4 has been buffered. Ignored for download_url results: download first, then call venice_video_complete.

tools.name: venice_video_complete
tools.description: Mark a completed video as downloaded and delete server-side media. Reports removal only when Venice confirms success. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

tools.name: venice_tts
tools.description: Convert text to speech. Supports cloned voices + emotion tags ([whispers], [sarcastically], etc.). When streaming=true, Venice streams upstream but this MCP tool buffers and returns one complete audio result; it does not emit incremental MCP chunks. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

input.description: Text to convert to speech (max 4096 chars).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Only supported by some TTS models; unsupported models ignore it.

streaming.description: Forward Venice's streaming flag. The MCP result is still buffered into one complete audio response, not delivered incrementally.

tools.name: venice_asr
tools.description: Transcribe audio. Fetches the URL server-side and forwards as multipart/form-data file upload. Upstream transcription JSON larger than 1 MiB is rejected so word/character timestamps cannot exhaust memory. Timestamp arrays and transcripts longer than 8000 characters are paged in the MCP result: such a transcription returns result_handle alongside the first page, and every later page must be requested with that handle so the clip is transcribed — and charged — exactly once. Handles are held in memory, per MCP session, for 10 minutes and only the 16 most recent survive, after which paging fails and a fresh transcription is needed. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

audio_url.description: Audio to transcribe. Required unless result_handle is supplied.

result_handle.description: Handle returned by an earlier paged transcription. Pages that retained result without submitting another transcription, so audio_url is ignored when this is set. Expires after 10 minutes or once 16 newer results are retained; an expired handle is an error rather than a silent re-transcription.

timestamps.description: Include word and character timestamps in JSON responses. Defaults to false.

timestamp_offset.description: Start index into each timestamp array (word/segment/char). Defaults to 0. Use result_handle to move past the first page.

timestamp_limit.description: Max entries returned per timestamp array. Defaults to 200. Follow next_timestamp_offset; it is null on the last page.

text_offset.description: Start character of the transcript page (8000 characters each). Defaults to 0. Use result_handle with next_text_offset to read past the first page.

tools.name: venice_voice_clone
tools.description: Discover or clone TTS voices. Action 'list' reads live per-model voice metadata from auth-free GET /v1/models?type=tts. Action 'create' requires sample_url, then uploads the sample to POST /v1/audio/voices for the chosen cloning model. Cloned voices come back as a `vv_<id>` handle; pass it as venice_tts voice together with the same model. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

action.description: list = fetch live TTS model voice metadata; create requires sample_url

sample_url.description: Required for action=create. Audio sample URL; tts-chatterbox-hd accepts MP3/WAV/FLAC/M4A, tts-minimax-speech-02-hd MP3/WAV only.

model.description: TTS model the cloned voice is paired with (action=create). Defaults to tts-chatterbox-hd.

tools.name: venice_music_generate
tools.description: Queue music generation. Available models: ace-step-15, elevenlabs-music, minimax-music-v2/v25/v26, stable-audio-25, mmaudio-v2-text-to-audio, elevenlabs-sound-effects-v2. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key. Returns { model, queue_id }; poll with venice_music_status.

duration_seconds.description: Optional duration in seconds as a positive integer or numeric string. Model-specific.

lyrics_prompt.description: Lyrics/text for lyric-capable models. Length limits come from model metadata.

lyrics_optimizer.description: Auto-generate lyrics. lyrics_prompt must be empty when enabled.

loop.description: Create a seamless loop on models reporting supports_loop.

language_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code on supported models.

speed.description: Model-specific speed multiplier. Check model min_speed/max_speed.

instrumental.description: Deprecated: use force_instrumental. Ignored when force_instrumental is set.

lyrics.description: Deprecated: use lyrics_prompt. Ignored when lyrics_prompt is set.

tools.name: venice_music_status
tools.description: Check status of a queued music job. Returns JSON progress while PROCESSING. Completed jobs are either an embedded base64 audio MCP resource or a download_url resource link. POST endpoint with body {model, queue_id}. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

delete_media_on_completion.description: Delete server-side media once embedded audio has been buffered. Ignored for download_url results: download first, then call venice_music_complete.

tools.name: venice_music_complete
tools.description: Mark a completed music job as downloaded and delete server-side media. Reports removal only when Venice confirms success. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

tools.name: venice_web_search
tools.description: Search the web with Brave Search (default, Zero Data Retention) or Google Search (proxied and anonymized by Venice). Returns structured results with titles, URLs, snippets, and dates. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

search_provider.description: brave (default) uses Zero Data Retention; google is proxied/anonymized by Venice.

tools.name: venice_web_scrape
tools.description: Scrape one URL into markdown text. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

tools.name: venice_text_parser
tools.description: Extract text from a document URL. Fetches the URL server-side and uploads the file as multipart/form-data. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

tools.name: venice_crypto_networks
tools.description: List the live, authoritative network slugs accepted by venice_crypto_rpc. No authentication required.

tools.name: venice_crypto_rpc
tools.description: Proxy one JSON-RPC request or a batch of up to 100 requests to a supported blockchain network. Use venice_crypto_networks for the live network list. For a simple call, pass rpc_method/rpc_params; for complete request IDs or batches, pass request. Relays (eth_sendRawTransaction, eth_sendUserOperation, Solana sendTransaction, and Starknet writes) must be sent as single requests (not batched) with idempotency_key; reuse the same key when retrying. Results are returned as compact JSON; responses larger than 64 KiB are rejected after Venice has billed them, so keep queries narrow. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

network.description: Network slug returned by venice_crypto_networks, e.g. "ethereum-mainnet".

params.description: Method parameters, by position (array) or by name (object).

id.description: Caller-supplied request ID. Defaults to 1 for a single request.
Required request ID used to correlate this batch item with its response.

request.description: A single JSON-RPC request object (ID optional) or a non-empty batch of at most 100 request objects (ID required per item).

rpc_method.description: Convenience form for a single request. Do not combine with request.

rpc_params.description: Parameters for rpc_method, by position (array) or by name (object).

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying a request. Required for eth_sendRawTransaction, eth_sendUserOperation, Solana sendTransaction, and Starknet writes so a lost response is not broadcast again.

tools.name: venice_tee_attestation
tools.description: Fetch hardware-attestation evidence for a TEE-capable text model. The caller must supply a fresh 32-byte nonce and independently verify the echoed nonce, Intel TDX quote, optional NVIDIA evidence, debug-mode state, and signing-key binding before trusting the key. Fetching this evidence does not itself establish E2EE. No authentication required.

model.description: TEE-capable text model id; check supportsTeeAttestation in venice_list_models.

nonce.description: Caller-generated 32-byte freshness challenge encoded as exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.

tools.name: venice_tee_signature
tools.description: Fetch the enclave signature for a completed TEE text-model chat request. The caller must cryptographically verify it against the signing identity bound by a separately verified attestation; this tool only returns the provider payload. No authentication required.

model.description: Same TEE-capable text model used for the chat completion.

tools.name: venice_list_models
tools.description: List the live model catalog, one page at a time. Omitting type lists every model type (sent upstream as type=all). Each entry is a compact summary (id, type, name, context length, enabled capabilities, traits, privacy, pricing); set verbose=true for the full upstream model objects. Returns total, next_offset, and every matching model id in ids; call again with offset=next_offset until next_offset is null. No authentication required.

type.description: Catalog type: text, image, inpaint, upscale, video, music, tts, asr, embedding, decision, "code", or "all" (default). Without a type Venice returns only text models, so pass one to find video, image or audio ids.

limit.description: Max models per page. Defaults to 50. A page may hold fewer when entries are large; follow next_offset.

offset.description: Index of the first model to return. Defaults to 0.

verbose.description: Return full upstream model objects instead of compact summaries. Defaults to false.

tools.name: venice_model_traits
tools.description: Return the live trait-name to model-id mapping for a model type. The API defaults to text when type is omitted. No authentication required.

type.description: Catalog type: text, image, inpaint, upscale, video, music, tts, asr, embedding, decision. Defaults to text upstream.

tools.name: venice_model_compatibility_mapping
tools.description: Return the live compatible model-name to Venice model-id mapping for a model type. The API defaults to text when type is omitted. No authentication required.

type.description: Catalog type: text, image, inpaint, upscale, video, music, tts, asr, embedding, decision. Defaults to text upstream.

tools.name: venice_model_details
tools.description: Get one exact model's full catalog row, including model_spec constraints, capabilities, and pricing when available. Requires a concrete type to keep the upstream catalog response bounded. No authentication required.

model_id.description: Exact model id, e.g. from venice_list_models({ type: "video" }).

type.description: Catalog type the model belongs to: text, image, inpaint, upscale, video, music, tts, asr, embedding, decision.

tools.name: venice_image_styles
tools.description: List image style presets available for venice_image_generate. No authentication required.

tools.name: venice_audio_quote
tools.description: Get a price quote for a music generation BEFORE queuing. Useful for budgeting. No authentication required.

duration_seconds.description: Optional duration in seconds as a positive integer or numeric string. Model-specific.

tools.name: venice_video_quote
tools.description: Get a price quote for a video generation BEFORE queuing. No authentication required.

duration.description: Duration as model-specific string enum, e.g. "4s", "6s", "8s".

tools.name: venice_list_characters
tools.description: List public Venice characters. API key required — this endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tag.description: Deprecated: use tags. A single tag, merged into tags.

tools.name: venice_get_character
tools.description: Get one public Venice character by slug. API key required — this endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tools.name: venice_character_reviews
tools.description: List paginated public reviews for a Venice character. API key required — this endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tools.name: venice_chat_with_character
tools.description: Chat with a Venice character by slug. Note: the character lookup itself is API-key-only, but the chat completion supports x402 — so x402 users may need to fetch character info via API key first. Uncensored: NSFW prompts allowed where the model permits.

tools.name: venice_billing_balance
tools.description: Get current USD, DIEM, and bundled-credit availability for the authenticated Venice account. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tools.name: venice_billing_usage_analytics
tools.description: Get beta aggregated usage by date, model, and API key. Data is cached for 10 minutes. Choose either lookback or a complete start/end date range. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

lookback.description: Relative lookback from 1d through 90d. Cannot be combined with start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: Inclusive custom range start in YYYY-MM-DD format. Requires end_date.

end_date.description: Custom range end in YYYY-MM-DD format. Requires start_date.

tools.name: venice_billing_usage_history
tools.description: Walk detailed billing usage in ascending timestamp order using cursor pagination. Supports complete JSON or upstream CSV pages, defaulting to 10 rows. Pages exceeding 64 KiB fail without returning partial rows or a next cursor. On continuation, send cursor without the original filters; CSV nextCursor values already encode format=csv so a cursor-only follow-up stays on text/csv. This uses /billing/usage-history, never deprecated /billing/usage. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. CSV pages return a csv: prefix so continuation stays on text/csv. Cannot be combined with filters or page_size.

start_timestamp.description: Inclusive first-page lower bound, ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix.

end_timestamp.description: Exclusive first-page upper bound, ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix.

page_size.description: First-page row count. Defaults to 10. Complete pages larger than 64 KiB are rejected; use smaller pages or narrower timestamp filters.

format.description: Defaults to json. Optional on continuation; CSV nextCursor values already stay on CSV.

tools.name: venice_list_api_keys
tools.description: List active API-key metadata, including only the documented last six characters—not full key secrets. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tools.name: venice_get_api_key
tools.description: Get metadata, usage, balances, and rate-limit details for one API-key ID. The documented response does not reveal the full key secret. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

id.description: API-key ID, not the key secret.

tools.name: venice_api_key_rate_limits
tools.description: Get the current key's balances, access status, tier, expiration, and model-specific rate limits. API key required — this endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tools.name: venice_api_key_rate_limit_logs
tools.description: Get the last 50 exceeded rate-limit events for the account. This read-only endpoint is experimental. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

tools.name: venice_x402_balance
tools.description: Check the prepaid x402 credit balance for an EVM or Solana wallet address. SIWX-ONLY: this endpoint rejects API key auth and requires SIGN-IN-WITH-X (forwarded from VENICE_SIWX_TOKEN). The wallet in the path must match the SIWX-authenticated wallet.

tools.name: venice_x402_top_up_info
tools.description: Fetch the x402 top-up payment requirements: the accepted USDC payment options (currently Base and Solana), each with network, asset, receiver wallet (payTo), minimum amount in base units, and settlement timeout. Sends an empty POST with no payment header, so nothing is charged. Signing and PAYMENT-SIGNATURE submission happen OUTSIDE this MCP server. No authentication required.

tools.name: venice_x402_transactions
tools.description: List recent x402 top-up + debit transactions for an EVM or Solana wallet. SIWX-ONLY: rejects API key, requires SIGN-IN-WITH-X (VENICE_SIWX_TOKEN). The wallet in the path must match the SIWX-authenticated wallet.

instructions: Venice MCP exposes uncensored, privacy-respecting AI inference (LLM, image, video, TTS, ASR, music) via Venice.ai. Auth: set VENICE_API_KEY, or set VENICE_SIWX_TOKEN to a pre-signed EVM or Solana SIGN-IN-WITH-X payload. See https://docs.venice.ai/mcp for full reference.
